# 夹具：合规 —— 参数来自配置，常量具名，必要处给出豁免理由
import numpy as np

HASH_PREFIX_LEN = 12


def train(df, cfg):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(cfg["seed"])
    sample = df.sample(n=cfg["sample_size"], random_state=cfg["seed"])
    threshold = cfg["threshold"]
    fold_count = 5  # 魔数豁免: 五折交叉验证是 M6 冻结口径，非可调参数
    return rng, sample, threshold, fold_count, HASH_PREFIX_LEN
